lead.ar: خدمة مساندة للنزاعات المنظورة، يهيّئ فيها البرنامج المكان والتواصل بين الأطراف وناظري المنازعة لتسهيل الإجراءات.
lead.en: A support service for disputes under review: the program provides the venue and handles communication between the parties and those hearing the dispute, to ease the proceedings.

gets.ar: تهيئة مكان جلسات النظر في النزاع
gets.en: Providing the venue for the dispute sessions

gets.ar: تنسيق التواصل بين الأطراف وناظري المنازعة
gets.en: Coordinating communication between the parties and those hearing the dispute
Easing the proceedings through to their conclusion

text.en: Submitting a request for a dispute under review.
Arranging the venue and the schedule.
Liaising between the parties and those hearing the dispute.
Following the proceedings through to their conclusion.

audience.ar: أطراف النزاعات المنظورة في المنشآت والأوقاف العائلية
audience.en: Parties to disputes under review in family businesses and endowments
Those hearing disputes, such as mediators and arbitrators

duration.en: For as long as the dispute is under review
